name: s_m2Cache
meaning: Holds the model cache

name: s_m2LightGridScale
meaning: Holds the scale from world units to a scene light grid cell

name: s_m2GroupBuckets
meaning: Holds the buckets of the batch grouping hash, -1 when empty

name: s_m2TextureCenter
meaning: Holds (0.5, 0.5, 0), the centre texture transforms rotate and scale about

name: s_m2SkinVertices
meaning: Holds the vertex skinning routine the CPU features select

name: s_softFloatZero
meaning: Holds 0.0, set by 0x7625e0; the floor and ceil read it

name: s_softFloatOne
meaning: Holds 1.0, set by 0x762e20; the ceil reads it

name: s_softFloatHundredth
meaning: Holds 0x3c23d70a, 0.01, set by 0x7626e0; the software modifier applier reads it

name: s_softFloatHalf
meaning: Holds 0.5, set by 0x762be0; 0x761160 adds it

name: s_softFloatMinusOne
meaning: Holds -1.0, set by 0x762520; the floor reads it

name: s_topInfinity
meaning: Holds +inf, the top file's copy of the shared header's value

name: s_lastInputTime
meaning: Holds the time of the last key or mouse event the top's handlers received

name: s_simpleTop
meaning: Points to the CSimpleTop its constructor stores; its destructor stores 0

name: s_layoutQueueLinkOffset
meaning: Holds 0x6c, the offset of the layout queue link in a layout frame

name: s_layoutQueueTail
meaning: Points to the layout queue terminator's previous link, the tail

name: s_layoutQueueHead
meaning: Points to the first queued layout frame, tagged by bit 0 when empty

name: s_frameTypeId
meaning: Holds the script type id of Frame, assigned on first use

name: s_dragThresholdSq
meaning: Holds 0.0001, the squared distance a pressed frame moves before its drag starts

name: s_frameCount
meaning: Counts the CSimpleFrame objects that exist

name: s_regionTypeId
meaning: Holds the script type id of Region, assigned on first use

name: s_modelTypeId
meaning: Holds the model frame type id, assigned from a counter on first use

name: s_frameMethodHash
meaning: Holds the hash table of the Frame methods

name: s_regionMethodHash
meaning: Holds the hash table of the Region methods

name: s_layoutUndefined
meaning: Holds +inf, the value of an edge or point the layout cannot resolve

name: s_cameraPropertyInfinity
meaning: Holds +inf, set at startup; nothing reads it

name: s_cameraInvTwoPi
meaning: Holds 1/2π (0x3e22f983), set at startup, read by 0x7abbe0

name: s_cameraTwoPi
meaning: Holds 2π (0x40c90fdb), set at startup, read by 0x7abbe0

name: s_defaultFov
meaning: Holds π/2, set at startup, the default field of view

name: s_cameraInfinity
meaning: Holds +inf, set at startup; nothing reads it

name: s_cameraInvTwoPi2
meaning: Holds 1/2π, set at startup; nothing reads it

name: s_cameraTwoPi2
meaning: Holds 2π, set at startup; read only by 0x7adf50

name: s_particleRegistryInfinity
meaning: Holds +inf, set at startup; nothing reads it

name: s_particleRegistry
meaning: Holds the particle emitter registry, created on first use

name: s_ribbonRegistry
meaning: Holds the ribbon emitter registry, created on first use

name: s_particleCameraDistance
meaning: Holds the distance from the last updated emitter to the camera

name: s_particleNoise
meaning: Holds 128 uniform values in [0, 1) the particle code draws from

name: s_geometryInvTwoPi
meaning: Holds 1/2π, 0.15915494, from start-up

name: s_geometryTwoPi
meaning: Holds 2π, 6.2831855, from start-up

name: s_sharedInfinity
meaning: Holds +∞ from start-up

name: s_sharedInvTwoPi
meaning: Holds 1/2π, 0.15915494, from start-up

name: s_movementTwoPi
meaning: Holds 2π, written only by the static initializer 0x7c5dd0

name: s_recordInfinity
meaning: Holds +∞ from start-up

name: s_contextTableGuard
meaning: Holds the guard bit of the context table's one-time setup

name: s_nextContextHandle
meaning: Holds the last context handle given out

name: s_contextTableLocks
meaning: Holds the read-write locks of the context table's eight buckets

name: s_skillLineRecAllocatorBuilt
meaning: Holds bit 0 once the ability node pool is built; default 0, written by 0x6e0830

name: s_skillLineRecAllocator
meaning: Holds the ability node pool: element size, per block, in use, block list, free list
